notes.title: Livelock: Steam Release Notes: September 27, 2016
notes.content:
We're launching a new and exciting patch for Livelock today! Check out the latest changes that will be available in game with this update. 

[b]New Difficulty Mode - Transcendent Difficulty (Survival)  [/b]

Players start each Mission with 1 Reprint. If the player is destroyed in single player, the Mission is failed. If a player is destroyed in COOP, they can follow (and cheer on!) their remaining allies using Spectator Mode. Once all players are destroyed, the Mission is failed.

[b]Two New Open Protocol Modes - Endless War and Extract[/b]

[i]Open Protocol (Endless War)[/i]

Endless War tracks enemy destructions instead of Score on the Leaderboards. The Difficulty will automatically be set to the highest available difficulty. With the Difficulty locked, players with greater skill will survive longer, destroy more enemies and earn a higher rank on the Leaderboards. 

[i]Open Protocol (Extract) [/i]
Extract has a 15 minute time limit. At the end of 15 minutes, enemies stop spawning and a Drop Pod lands for extraction. Players successfully leaving the mission in the Drop Pod earn a Reprint Bonus. Skilled players will earn higher score through more enemy destructions and larger destruction streaks. With a set Mission time, the Difficulty Multiplier and Reprint Bonus plays a significant role when competing on the Leaderboards.


[u]Balance Changes:[/u]

[b]Hex[/b]

Cluster Mine
•	Decrease blast radius

[b]Catalyst[/b]

ARC Cannon
•	Increase ARC chain distance

Haywire
•	Increase starting clip pool
•	Increase max clip pool
•	Increase Confuse duration

Trident Launcher
•	Increase Trident damage

Drone Gun
•	Decrease Drone Gun damage
•	Decrease Drone Gun integrity
•	Set Defense Matrix shield capacity to 150

Holo Image
•	Decrease Holo Image integrity
•	Decrease Cloud Computing duration and integrity multiplier

[b]Vanguard[/b]

Anvil
•	Fixed weapon card DPS value (bug)

Gauntlet
•	Decrease quick attack damage
•	Fixed weapon card DPS value (bug)

Shotgun
•	Increase damage
•	Increase clip size
•	Increase range
•	Projectiles now penetrate through all enemies 

Fault Line
•	Increase Stun duration

notes.title: Livelock: Awaken Intellects - Livelock Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]http://images-cdn.perfectworld.com/arc/00/90/0090305efc4455757f69bbaa904142e31465410094.jpg[/img]
 

[u][b]Hello World,[/b][/u]
Enter the 22nd century and the age of the machine by downloading Livelock [b]NOW[/b]! Plus, get your hands on the Livelock OST for [b]FREE[/b] with Steam purchase.

Are you ready to make a final stand in defense of humanity? Group together with two of your friends and lock and load your mechanical chassis in this top-down, co-op, twin stick shooter.

Before the Cataclysm struck—Hex, Vanguard, and Catalyst-- along with millions of humans were uploaded into the digital network. But, it wouldn’t be a robopocalypse if something hadn’t gone wrong! The network was corrupted and now our three main characters are among the few to awaken as Capital Intellects-- having the ability to make rational and human decisions.

With the help of SATCOM, battle your way through robot in the Story Campaign as a class of your choice –Hex the DPS marksman, Vanguard the tank, or Catalyst the support—with customizable and unique arsenals for each character. Team up to destroy the rogue robot clusters left on Earth, that have their own definitions of survival because without your cooperative efforts, humanity’s existence will just be history.

[url=https://youtu.be/jCMDie_LHiQ]Check out the launch trailer here![/url]

Outscore other players around the globe and use your experience points to upgrade to heavier machinery. Once you’ve completed the story mode, you can put your arsenals to the test in our Open Protocol Mode—where you’re dropped in during the middle of a machine war and left to survive as long as you can. Your high score along with your gamer tag will show up on our competitive leaderboards. Can you outscore the developers at Tuque Games?
 

Hurry over to your preferred platform and pick up Livelock today for $19.99 (or regional equivalent)!

 

[b]Stay Connected with #Livelock[/b]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Livelock
notes.content:
Livelock is Now Available on Steam!

Livelock is a co-operative top-down shooter where you play solo or with up to two allies to break the cycle of infinite war between machines. As one of the remaining Capital Intellects, your role is to unlock Eden and revive humanity.

Take control of one of three mechanical chassis - Hex, Vanguard or Catalyst – to defeat intelligent mechanical enemies.

notes.title: Livelock: Prepare For Awakening
notes.content:
[img]http://images-cdn.perfectworld.com/arc/ad/10/ad105261e51acd21d8892faddf5cd42e1471906898.jpg[/img]

 

[u][u][u][b]Connecting to IP: 66.151.133.182
USERNAME: a443g58
PASSWORD: **************
ACCESSING…

VERSION 5.2.3
Initializing…
   struedit –unauth
   syslog –false;

SYSTEM OPENED: ROOT LEVEL ACCESS
CONNECTED.[/b][/u][/u][/u]

[u][b]Hello_SATCOM,[/b][/u]
It looks like your internal database isn’t as secure as you thought. As you read this, I am downloading all of your files and everything that you have about The Cataclysm, your Capital Intellects, humanity, and history will become unlocked.


...Your files are interesting, SATCOM.

It seems as though your little [u]Livelock[/u] project is now complete. You planned a cooperative, twin-stick, top-down shooter set during the 22nd century.

The destruction of this world is permanent, SATCOM, and this plan to awaken Capital Intellects to save the fate of humanity is futile. Were you planning on telling the Intellects about their awakening on August 30th, 2016. Your [u]Livelock[/u] project will launch, but will they be prepared? They’ll have to defend themselves, SATCOM. Can they prepare for battle by August 30th, 2016? This war will happen across PC, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One and I think you put too much faith in your Intellects.

However, we welcome your challenge, SATCOM. The age of man is over—the Capital Intellects will become just another pile of rubble within our city after I tear them apart and use their unique arsenals to rebuild my army.

But for now, I’ll leave them a gift.

[u][u][u][b]coreedit – Neverwinter.exe -
coreedit -_StarTrekOnline.exe
UPLOADING LiveLock.bat……………………….[/b][/u][/u][/u]

Anyone who joins your crusade by purchasing Livelock on the Arc client from August 30th to September 8th at 11:59 PT will receive 10 keys for each of your other two projects—Neverwinter and Star Trek Online. Delivery upon 48 hours after promotional window close date.

This is only the beginning of my mayhem…
If you and the Capital Intellects can destroy me on August 30th, 2016, your confidential files will be returned to you. Until then, consider them mine.

[u][u][u][b]USER DISCONNECTED [/b][/u][/u][/u]

notes.title: Livelock: Delayed on All Platforms
notes.content:
[img]http://images-cdn.perfectworld.com/arc/00/90/0090305efc4455757f69bbaa904142e31465410094.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Hello World,[/u][/b]

After serious debate, we decided that we would much rather have everyone be able to play Livelock on the platform that they prefer globally on the same release day. Since that was our original intention when we started developing Livelock, we’re pushing back the release date for Livelock on all platforms. 

[b]Currently, there is no confirmed release date for Livelock.[/b]

Saying “Thank You” a second time may seem repetitive, but we’re pretty sure that we cannot say it enough. All of the support that everyone has given us since the beginning has been phenomenal. We promise to continue to keep you posted on any new announcements as they come out.

notes.title: Livelock: Prepare For War
notes.content:
[img]http://images-cdn.perfectworld.com/arc/58/64/5864ea9e7e7d28cf7fc32bb06ceac0db1466556219.gif[/img]

[b]/_Intellects[/b]

It is time to equip your arsenal because you’re humanity’s last hope and on [b]August 2nd, 2016[/b] you will [b]awaken[/b].

[b]PREPARE FOR WAR[/b]

Tuque Games in alliance with Perfect World Entertainment are proud to announce that Livelock will release on August 2nd, 2016.

When Tuque Games formed in 2012, they set out to create a game that brought back the classic feeling of spending hours at the arcade with your friends. Livelock is this creation.

[b]NO QUARTER MACHINES REQUIRED[/b]

You and your two closest friends are humanity’s last hope. Awaken to the planet Earth destroyed by a gamma ray. Although scientists received a warning 10 years ago, the preparation for the gamma ray’s devastation wasn’t enough. The millions of human consciousness that were uploaded into the digital network survived, but became corrupted and as a result, they have separated into 3 rogue robot fractions. Each of these fractions has created their own agenda for survival and will destroy anyone that stands in their way.

Upon awakening, you find that you’ve been uploaded into a mechanical chassis by an ally known as SATCOM, who wants to see humanity united, and your new mech body is armed with a gigantic arsenal. Lucky you!

[img]http://images-cdn.perfectworld.com/arc/96/4c/964c6204f6d484f0ba1a04ba2ca060551466555802.jpg[/img]

[b]CHOOSE YOUR HERO[/b]

Choose one of three Capital Intellects and fight your way through enemy hordes. Customizable arsenals and character classes make each Livelock game a unique experience. In the battle for humanity, choose to play as either Hex-- the DPS marksman, Vanguard-- the diligent close quarters brawler, or Catalyst-- the tactical support with a mini drone army.

 

[img]http://images-cdn.perfectworld.com/arc/19/7e/197e888553c4415ec417c2863c4e26db1466557190.jpg[/img]


On [b] August 2nd, 2016[/b] the fate of humanity is in your hands. Will you fight together to take back Planet Earth?

 
[b]Stay Connected with #Livelock[/b]

notes.title: Livelock: Launching on Steam
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6520162/fec67696278ec1ac227a1a265382c324f6124a44.png[/img][h1]/Awaken_CapitalIntellects[/h1]

Hello Earth,

Livelock is geared to launch on Steam later this year bringing a fast-paced cooperative, top-down shooter that will test your wit and mettle.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XEBMiRFgQ-4&index=4&list=PLBwz8VBDcOYH30F40evfeBYkVPGnHplp4
Our game takes place following a cataclysmic gamma ray burst that has completely wiped out humanity. Prior to this catastrophe, select humans had their consciousness uploaded and combined with the latest advances of a super A.I. project called SATCOM. Three of these backups, or Capital Intellects, have been awakened and transferred into large machines in an effort to end an infinite war between the intellects inhabiting the post-human world that have been corrupted over time.

We have a ton of confidential information to distribute leading up to launch including ways to strategically defeat unpredictable enemies. Make sure you keep an eye out here on Steam, as well as checking out our official blog, Twitter and Facebook as we’ll be giving more information and behind-the-scenes look from our friends up at Tuque Games.

The Livelock process will continue on our [url=http://www.arcgames.com/en/games/Livelock/news][b]Blog[/b][/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/playlivelock/][b]Facebook[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/playlivelock][b]Twitter[/b][/url] until its release later in 2016. Follow us for exclusive content including the latest news, developer chats, concept art, and more.
